set.notes: Professional multimedia animation remains deferred; the Classic forms play through the platform media framework (docs/video.md).
FTP is a permanent compatibility stub with terminal-safe neutral state and is never reported as implemented.
Explicit project policy classifies FTP compatibility as Never in the Professional profile.

set.description: OpenDBC desktop OpenXR addition shared by DBC and DBPro; not a historical DarkBASIC command.
set.notes: See docs/vr.md for meter units, tracking, validation, defaults and unavailable-device behavior.
Historical DBPro readers also available in Classic for Vector3 values written by the shared VR GET commands; readers alone do not request an XR device.
